race.description: 2026 Psp Peak Of The Creek Heat 3
race.comment: VINKE B NZ (6) put the writing on the wall when runner-up in his first outing for the new yard two back then toughed it out nicely after racing parked at the most recent appearance at this circuit and distance, getting home by a head. Draws wider but looks a big chance to take this out too. SHANKYS SHOT NZ (10) drew wide and went back when resuming last start but produced a long run to finish third at this venue. Draws on the back row but is proven second-up so should be improved and hasn't missed a place at this shorter distance. SURREAL MORAN NZ (3) draws well again and won his only third-up attempt so looks is a chance after placing in both outings off a spell. JAMES ALFRED (5) is fitter for recent racing and draws a little lower than last start so may be competitive.
